d:
A global Microsoft 365 outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, Copilot and Defender in at least 74 countries, and IndiGo and Akasa's email support went down with it. Microsoft says it wasn't a cyberattack, but it still can't say what caused it. Vrinda Tulsian explains what went wrong and why India should be worried.
